correctness.rationale: Exact orbit compatibility has same-type threshold one, mixed threshold two. All cliques lie in a cube square; each block is C4*C4=S3. Distinct block intersections sit in an explicitly contractible-over-edges one-skeleton, whose square-boundary intersections are S1. The null gluing maps split one S3 per square, and replacing each sphere block by a cone gives the simply connected cubical two-skeleton; integer Whitehead gives the claimed S2 wedge and no torsion. A standalone direct distance/face/GF(2) checker confirms n=2 through 8, but is not used to infer the infinite claim.
